verdict.rationale: Factory strongly supports reviewing automation output — diff review before merge, PR/MR code review, inline comments (factory-docs-1, factory-docs-18, factory-docs-19, factory-docs-38, factory-docs-39) — and its CLI/git-workflow integration implies changes are versioned through normal git history (factory-docs-2). However, there is no explicit documentation of versioning or rolling back Missions, Skills, or Custom Droids themselves (e.g., reverting a Skill definition or undoing a completed Mission), only Markdown-file packaging that could theoretically be git-tracked. Missing for 10: explicit rollback/undo mechanism for automations, version history UI for Missions/Skills, and any evidence of reverting an executed automation rather than just reviewing a diff before it lands.
